title: The tea-tasting experiment
caption: With 4 milk-first cups among 8, a guesser chooses 4 cups in one of C(8, 4) = 70 ways. 3 right can happen in 16 ways and 4 right in 1, so P(at least 3) = 17/70 ≈ 0.243.
alt: Bar chart of the 70 equally likely choices by the number of correct cups: 1, 16, 36, 16, 1 for 0 to 4; the bars for 3 and 4 are highlighted.
description: A guesser picks which 4 of the 8 cups were milk-first: 70 ways.
